page_title: PAR 1-3 LEC | Parma v Lecce 31/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' 1 - 3 Goal! Nikola Krstovic plays it to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Zion Suzuki. 1:3.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Drissa Camara (Parma) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
88' 7:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
84' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
80' Wonderful movement by Lecce. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
79' Having seen unsporting behavior, Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is the recipient.
77' Parma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
75' Matteo Cancellieri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jacob Ondrejka (Parma).

75' Milan Djuric (Parma) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom left corner of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Gaby Jean (Lecce) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simone Sozza no option but to blow his whistle.
69' Here is a change. Mandela Keita is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
69' Lautaro Valenti will be replaced by Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:4.

63' 1 - 2 Goal! Nikola Krstovic displays great vision and sends a pass to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:2.

61' Drissa Camara (Parma) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
60' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 42:58.
56' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Jesper Karlsson will be replaced by Tete Morente (Lecce).
56' A substitution has been made. Ylber Ramadani goes off and Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) comes on.
55' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
54' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a comfortable save.
48' Parma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
46' A quickly taken corner by Parma.
46' The game is over for Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma). Drissa Camara comes on for the second half.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A pass from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Valentin Mihaila is substituted due to injury. Fabio Pecchia gives a chance to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma).
44' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner which is cleared.
42' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Wladimiro Falcone.
39' Milan Djuric (Parma) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

36' 1 - 1 It's in! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the right of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Thorir Johann Helgason. 1:1.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Emanuele Valeri (Parma) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Wladimiro Falcone.
33' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is going to take the penalty!
32' The Parma players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
31' Play continues despite the shouts by some Parma players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Simone Sozza interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
31' Surely that's handball by one of the Lecce players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
30' The free kick from long range, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

29' The cross fools the defence and leaves Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
27' A cross into the box from Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is cleared.
26' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Lecce players look gutted.
25' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Lecce goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
24' Goal! Santiago Pierotti plays it to Nikola Krstovic (Lecce), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Zion Suzuki. 0:1.
21' Great touch by Valentin Mihaila (Parma) as he received a precise pass on the edge of the box. His powerful shot bounced off the goalkeeper’s gloves and hit the post.
21' Parma continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
20' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is the one who receives a yellow card.
19' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

18' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
15' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
13' Lecce are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
9' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
5' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
2' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Simone Sozza will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
